title: LLM Code Smells: A Taxonomy and Detection Approach
abstract: arXiv:2605.22976v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into software systems for diverse purposes, due to their versatility, flexibility, and ability to simulate human reasoning to some extent. However, poor integration of LLM inference in source code can undermine software system quality. Therefore, inadequate LLM integration coding practices must be documented to help developers mitigate such issues. Following our earlier work on LLM code smells, this paper consolidates and refines the concept by presenting a self-contained taxonomy and a catalog of nine LLM code smells. We also create SpecDetect4LLM, a static source code analysis tool for their detection, and conduct extensive empirical evaluations of its detection effectiveness (precision and recall) as well as the prevalence of LLM code smells across 692 open-source software projects (171,194 source files). translated_title: LLM代码坏味道：分类体系与检测方法
translated_abstract: 由于大语言模型（LLM）具有多功能性、灵活性以及在一定程度上模拟人类推理的能力，它们正越来越多地被集成到软件系统中以实现多种用途。然而，LLM推理在源代码中的不良集成可能会损害软件系统的质量。因此，必须记录不恰当的LLM集成编码实践，以帮助开发者缓解此类问题。延续我们早期关于LLM代码坏味道的工作，本文通过提出一个独立的分类体系以及包含九种LLM代码坏味道的目录，巩固并完善了这一概念。我们还创建了SpecDetect4LLM——一个用于检测这些坏味道的静态源代码分析工具，并对其检测效果（精确率和召回率）以及LLM代码坏味道在692个开源软件项目（171,194个源文件）中的普遍程度进行了广泛的实证评估。我们的结果表明，73.5%的可分析项目受到LLM代码坏味道的影响。
tldr: 本文提出了LLM代码坏味道的独立分类体系和九种坏味道目录，开发了静态分析工具SpecDetect4LLM进行检测，并通过对692个开源项目的实证评估发现73.5%的项目存在LLM代码坏味道。
en_tdlr: This paper consolidates the concept of LLM code smells with a self-contained taxonomy and a catalog of nine smells, develops the static analysis tool SpecDetect4LLM for detection, and empirically shows that 73.5% of 692 open-source projects are affected by LLM code smells.
